name: Hitsuka
source: A calm guy who is a member of the religious cult "Taiyou". He is loyal towards the cult's leader [url=/c57592]Michiru[/url] and is always next to her, explaining the things she says to others. Hitsuka also works as a security guard who guards off-limited areas and ensures that nobody enters them.
